thread:
Ivy (CSM): Quick heads-up: BorealisAI onboarding has stalled after our latest SDK update. New seats created dropped to zero in the last 48h. Renewal window is 2w. tagging for triage.

analytics-bot: Auto-alert BorealisAI: new_seats_48h: 38 -> 0 (-100%), api.errors: sdk.init.fail (3,120), sample error: "InvalidClientKey", dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/borealisai/health

Samir (Solutions Eng): Sounds like SDK auth handshake changed in 1.3.2. If they upgraded to 1.3.2 and didn't rotate keys, init will fail. Can we get a stacktrace from their CI?

Olga (Customer Ops): Their POC (ML Eng) left last week; new contact is procurement lead (J. Carver). Ben, any intel from your calls?

Ben (AE): Procurement mentioned they ran a small migration PoC with QuasarLabs last month. Quasar's slide claimed faster cold-starts and a migration toolkit. Customer hasn't signed yet but procurement is exploring options. We need to reduce friction fast.

Ivy (CSM): Proposed immediate steps: 1) admin-runbook + hotkey to unblock onboarding 2) offer a 10-day onboarding concierge (CS+SE time) to finish integration 3) prepare neutral competitor comparison for procurement. Legal must review messaging before we promise any dedicated resources or credits.

Samir (Solutions Eng): Hotkey quick command for admins (48h validity):
```
# create temp admin key for onboarding
redwoodctl keys create --org borealisai --scope onboarding --expires 48h
```
I'll also draft a 1-page SDK rollback/upgrade checklist for their infra team.

Hannah (Legal): We can approve an offer for onboarding support hours and a temporary hotkey. Do not use wording like "trial" or "SLA" in client comms. If you intend to provide credits or Dedicated capacity, loop Legal + Finance first.

Olga (Customer Ops): I'll schedule a 30m onboarding concierge session with their infra team and Samir for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Ivy, want me to include Ben on the procurement thread?

Ben (AE): Yes, please. Also can we get a short note comparing our SDK migration path vs QuasarLabs? Keep it factual: supported languages, migration scripts, known edge-cases. I'll avoid pricing.

Ivy (CSM): Action items summarized:
- Samir: SDK checklist + hotkey by EOD
- Olga: schedule concierge session and intro to new procurement lead
- Ben: draft competitor comparison bullets (procurement-friendly)
- Hannah: review outreach language before send

billing-bot: FYI: Temporary onboarding keys and support hours are charged at normal metered/support rates unless Finance approves credits. If you want to offer credits, open a billing exceptions ticket.

analytics-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will post an alert if new_seats_48h doesn't show >= 20 within 24h. :eyes:
